Update Microsoft Word document with multiple modes:

**MODE: replace_all (default)** - Replace entire document:
  execute_tool('microsoft_word_update_content', document_id='abc123', content='New content', mode='replace_all')

**MODE: append** - Add content to end:
  execute_tool('microsoft_word_update_content', document_id='abc123', content='Additional content', mode='append')

**MODE: find_replace** - Find and replace specific text:
  execute_tool('microsoft_word_update_content', document_id='abc123', content='New text', mode='find_replace', find_text='Old text')

mode.description: Update mode: 'replace_all' (clear + write new), 'append' (add to end), 'find_replace' (find and replace)

find_text.description: Text to find and replace (required when mode='find_replace')

additional_tools.returns: Dict with success status, mode, content_length, and mode-specific details

additional_tools.name: microsoft_word_smart_create_from_markdown
additional_tools.short_description: SMART: Create Microsoft Word document from markdown text with automatic formatting conversion
additional_tools.description:
🚨 CRITICAL EXECUTION RULES:
(1) ALWAYS execute THIS tool NOW - NEVER reference 'I created earlier' or use conversation history
(2) MUST return format: **[Name]** | ID: `[id]` | URL: [full_url] | Link: [title](url)
(3) Use EXACT values from tool response - NEVER make up fake URLs/IDs
(4) If tool fails, say 'Failed to create' - NEVER pretend it succeeded

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='microsoft_word_smart_create_from_markdown', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

🤖 SMART TOOL v2.0: Create professionally formatted Word document from markdown with FULL FORMATTING support. Converts AI-generated markdown into native Word formatting using python-docx library.

✨ COMPLETE MARKDOWN SUPPORT (30+ Features):

📝 TEXT FORMATTING:
- **bold** or __bold__ → Bold text
- *italic* or _italic_ → Italic text
- __underline__ → Underlined text (double underscore)
- ~~strikethrough~~ → Strikethrough text
- ==highlight== → Yellow highlighted text
- `inline code` → Monospace code
- H~2~O → Subscript (H₂O)
- x^2^ → Superscript (x²)

📊 STRUCTURE:
- # to ###### → 6 heading levels (H1-H6)
- - or * → Bullet lists
- 1. 2. 3. → Numbered lists
-   - (2 spaces) → Nested lists (unlimited levels)
- | Tables | → Professional tables with styling
- ```code blocks``` → Monospace code blocks
- > Blockquotes → Indented quotes

🎨 SPECIAL ELEMENTS:
- --- or *** → Horizontal line
- <<PAGE-BREAK>> or <<PAGE_BREAK>> → Force a page break in the document

markdown.description: Markdown source to convert into a Word document (supports full markdown features listed above)

name.description: Desired document name (will append .docx if not present)

folder_id.description: OneDrive folder ID where the document will be saved (default: root)

style_template.description: Optional style template or theme to apply

export_pdf.description: Also export generated doc to PDF

additional_tools.returns: Dict with document_id, name, web_url, created_datetime, and optional pdf_url
use_cases: Convert AI-generated markdown into a polished Word report
Convert README or technical markdown into a shareable Word doc
Generate client-facing deliverables from markdown templates

user_facing_language.capability_description: I can convert markdown into a fully formatted Word document, preserving headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and special formatting (highlights, subscripts, superscripts).
example_ai_responses: I'll convert your markdown into a polished Word document and save it to OneDrive.
I'll generate 'Project Summary.docx' from the markdown you provided and include a table of contents.
